name: Vorenor Winterbourne

abilities.name: Blood Drain
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does moderate physical damage and heals Vorenor for roughly twice the damage done.

abilities.name: Open Wounds
abilities.description: Vorenor Winterbourne shoots a red beam at a random player, dealing moderate magic damage over 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Blood Pool
abilities.description: Vorenor Winterbourne places a pool of blood under a random player. The pool deals continuous direct moderate-high physical damage as indicated by a red circle and each hit heals Vorenor for ~x1,75 times the damage done. The initial tick happens almost immediately, thus the healer should ensure that the party is fully healed before this attack is performed.

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
abilities.description: Vorenor Winterbourne teleports to each player one at a time and slashes them, dealing high physical damage each time.

abilities.name: Thrall Feast
abilities.description: Vorenor Winterbourne sucks blood from the captives around the room, healing himself 5 times per captive per cast for a very small amount of Health. At first, only one captive will be used, but as the fight progresses, more and more captives will be involved, increasing the magnitude of the healing done. To prevent this, players may kill the captives to stop his healing, however the captives have a lot of health and this ability heals Vorenor poorly so it is advised to solely focus on him instead, which also nets players the hard mode achievement. If no captives are left, Vorenor stops casting this ability.

summary: Vorenor Winterbourne is a Nord vampire found within Spindleclutch II, where he serves as the third and final boss that players must defeat. He leads the vampire clan found within the dungeon and has taken a number of civilians captive.
